text: Helinox is a South Korean outdoor-furniture brand described by the Hyundai Motorsport partners page as 'maker-founded and family-owned since 2008'; Genesis Magma Racing's partnership announcement calls Helinox a South Korean brand.
short: Helinox: South Korean, maker-founded and family-owned.

source.name: Hyundai Motorsport: Partners & Sponsors - Genesis Magma Racing (Helinox)
source.quote: Maker-founded and family-owned since 2008, today they are a hub of culture, creativity, and craft.
source.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. 'Helinox is an award-winning outdoor furniture company born from a simple idea: design a lightweight, packable chair. Maker-founded and family-owned since 2008' (under Genesis Magma Racing Partners > Official Partners).

additionalSources.name: Genesis Newsroom: Genesis Magma Racing announces South Korean brand Helinox as partner for 2026 FIA WEC season
additionalSources.quote: Genesis Magma Racing has appointed South Korean brand Helinox as its Official Outdoor Furniture Partner for the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship
